CONTACT FAQS

Before you
get in touch.

Practical details on confidentiality, sector exclusivity checks and how search, coaching and platform walkthroughs are scoped.

How quickly do you begin a search or review sector exclusivity?

Once we receive your brief, a director reviews current client commitments within one working day to confirm sector and territory availability before initiating confidential competitor mapping.

Do you work on retained search, contingency or partnership models?

We tailor the commercial agreement to the brief — retained search is recommended for confidential, senior and sector-exclusive mandates, while coaching and AI & business platforms are scoped cleanly in writing.

Is my client brief or candidate enquiry completely confidential?

Yes. We work under bilateral NDAs for client searches and never approach a candidate’s employer or share details without express written permission.
